headline: Sensex and Nifty end lower as crude oil surge and inflation concerns erase early gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Surge in crude oil prices triggered a sell-off in the broader market
RBI MPC flagged widening inflationary pressures in its latest meeting
Two RBI members opposed a hawkish stance, creating uncertainty
Profit booking occurred after the Sensex slumped over 900 points from its intraday high
whatHappening: Sensex declined 143.21 points to settle at 73,709.69 while Nifty dropped to 22,811.35
IT stocks outperformed the market and bucked the general downward trend
Navratri retail vehicle sales hit 11.23 lakh units led by two-wheelers and passenger vehicles
The market fell for the second straight session despite a strong start in early trade
summary: The Indian stock market closed in the red on October 21 as the Sensex and Nifty gave up early morning gains of up to 1%. Rising crude oil prices and RBI's warnings on inflationary pressures led to a significant sell-off from intraday highs. While the IT sector remained a bright spot, broader market sentiment was dampened by macroeconomic concerns.
